features.name: FHIR integration
features.implementation: Original upstream FHIR preserved; contradictory terminology flagged

features.name: Correct patient
features.implementation: Report and patient IDs verified; different repository patients stay separate

features.name: Consent and roles
features.implementation: Verified Hospital B clinician; report-scoped simulated consent, expiry, revocation and post-AI permission recheck

features.name: Source-linked summary
features.implementation: Bedrock selects canonical fact IDs; server renders only exact source statements

features.name: Changes and conflicts
features.implementation: Conflicting source code labels and partial birth dates flagged; no invented cross-patient trends

features.name: Text and voice
features.implementation: boto3 retrieval plus Nova 2 Lite text selection; Nova 2 Sonic transcription plus shared RAG plus Polly exact-text speech
features.verification: Live text, live audio workflow and source citation checks passed

features.name: Review and share
features.implementation: Clinician edits, approves current source version and exports readable HTML or original-FHIR package
features.limit: Recipient is the same authorized Hospital B treatment workflow; official FHIR profile validation still required
